power_real — 2D frequency op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "power_real", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: power_real (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

FFT の実部の絶対値 `|Re(F)| を正規化した画像(fft_image` の対数
